properties.name: Canadian Institute for Advanced Research
properties.notes: Listed by the source under Canadian AI Institutes as "Canadian Institute for Advanced Research (Toronto, ON)". Known as CIFAR. Its remit is national rather than Ontario-specific — it convenes and funds research across Canada — so it appears here on the strength of its Toronto head office, not because its work is confined to the province. Organisation's own site: https://cifar.ca/
